objective.title: We're launching our app this week and need a social media…

outcome.intent: Produce an evidence-informed, cross-platform social media launch plan for the app covering TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X, with clear audience, messaging, content, timing, measurement, and launch decisions.

levels.label: Launch scope defined
levels.statement: The app launch audience, business objective, launch window, and success definitions are explicitly bounded well enough to evaluate social media work.

levels.label: Trend evidence synthesized
levels.statement: Relevant current audience and content trends for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X are synthesized alongside the company’s available product and audience information, with evidence limitations identified.

levels.label: Cross-platform plan complete
levels.statement: A coherent social media launch plan exists for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X, including audience, positioning, channel-specific content direction, launch timing, measurement, and decision criteria grounded in the available evidence.

levels.label: Launch ready
levels.statement: The completed social media launch plan is internally consistent, executable during the stated launch window, and sufficient for the company to make launch publishing and evaluation decisions without unresolved blocking questions.

requirements.mustBeTrue: The plan is grounded in current, relevant public evidence about audience and content trends across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X, together with the company’s available product, audience, and launch information; evidence recency, relevance, and limitations are stated.
requirements.title: Current evidence and company context are synthesized

requirements.mustBeTrue: The app’s priority launch audience, relevant market assumptions, launch window, business objective, and measurable success definitions are explicit and consistent with the evidence summary.
requirements.title: Launch audience and success definition are bounded

requirements.mustBeTrue: The app has a clear launch value proposition, audience-relevant message hierarchy, proof points or substantiation boundaries, and consistent calls to action suitable for the defined audience and success criteria.
requirements.title: Launch messaging is coherent

requirements.mustBeTrue: The plan specifies the intended role, audience fit, content emphasis, publishing requirements, and adaptation boundaries for TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X, while preserving a coherent app launch narrative across platforms.
requirements.title: Platform-specific content direction is defined

requirements.mustBeTrue: The plan covers the stated pre-launch and post-launch window with an ordered content schedule, sufficient coverage of the defined messages and audience needs, and clearly stated timing assumptions.
requirements.title: Launch timing and content coverage are complete

requirements.mustBeTrue: The plan defines platform-relevant measures, attribution or signal limitations, reporting intervals, and decision rules that connect observed results to the app launch objectives.
requirements.title: Measurement and decision rules are defined

requirements.mustBeTrue: A single internally consistent recommendation identifies the prioritized launch direction, its evidence basis, key assumptions, expected outcomes, dependencies, risks, and unresolved non-blocking limitations across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and X.
requirements.title: The integrated launch recommendation is decision-ready

requirements.mustBeTrue: The plan distinguishes information that is adequately supported by company records or public evidence from information that remains uncertain, and states whether any remaining gap could materially change the launch recommendation.
